goal: Add a durable trusted compiler-backed primitive that reconstructs a canonical I09 task-context pack from a small stage request and creates only the exact unattached Git blob needed by the unchanged task-context publisher.

verified_facts.statement: Issue #56 was claimed from exact protected hwm-control/main 106718a5d0cf4db38afc9f365def883be27ffc76 on the sole ownership branch agent/infra-0056-task-context-blob-staging; claim bookkeeping commit is 0da2811deb6c54651ce9f261ac98c0cdb43f71f3.

GitHub exposes blob creation through coarse contents:write rather than an endpoint-level blob-only GITHUB_TOKEN scope; the owner correction accepts that residual platform capability only when the trusted stager operationally confines credentialed mutations to exact blob creation and the exact transport result comment.

provenance.reference: Dsamofalov/hwm-control#56 owner architecture correction and claim comment 5308854628

decisions.decision: Introduce forward-only hwm-task-context-stage-request/v1 and hwm-task-context-stage-result/v1 contracts without changing the existing task-context request, pack, publish-request or publish-result contracts.
decisions.rationale: The recurring gap is trusted blob staging, not deterministic compilation or publication semantics; a separate primitive preserves the already-protected boundaries.

decisions.decision: Permit job-scoped short-lived contents:write only in the protected stager upload job while enforcing a hard-coded credentialed API surface of POST /repos/Dsamofalov/hwm-context/git/blobs and POST /repos/Dsamofalov/hwm-context/issues/27/comments.
decisions.rationale: GitHub permission granularity is coarser than the required operational authority; code, workflow tests and live zero-delta evidence must enforce the narrower boundary.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Treat theoretical ref capability of contents:write as a terminal blocker.
rejected_alternatives.reason: The owner explicitly accepts the coarse GitHub platform limitation while requiring operational endpoint confinement and live proof of zero ref/PR/status mutation.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Widen hwm-task-context-publish-request/v1 to transport generated context bytes.
rejected_alternatives.reason: That would retroactively alter a merged publisher contract and preserve the large client-payload dependency instead of adding a recurring trusted staging primitive.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Introduce a PAT, deploy key or GitHub App credential.
rejected_alternatives.reason: The built-in short-lived repository-scoped GITHUB_TOKEN is sufficient and additional long-lived authority is forbidden.
